# Local phase-action density and the Write-activation map

Date: 2026-09-08. Conceptual direction: Sean Brady. Derivation, source-bound
adapter and native execution: Codex. Predecessor: H001081.

## 1. Objects and source identification

The installed RH J4 source has three independent phase roles, a, b and p,
with native phases phi_j=pi q_j/2 and q_j in Z4. Its contact account is

    E_1 = 6 - 2 cos(phi_a-phi_p) + 2 cos(phi_b-phi_p).       (1)

H001081 supplies its fixed-sphere chart and the owner papers' two equations:

    H_W9 = H_W8 + B Delta H_X1,      B in {0,1},
    dS = hbar dphi,                 S = integral L_A ds.    (2)

This campaign makes an explicit local source identification: the two signed
J4 couplings constitute a local reciprocal exchange witness, and the paper's
single Boolean X1 gate multiplies both. The continuous phase-pair extension
uses p_j=(cos phi_j,sin phi_j), agreeing with every installed native phase.
Neither identification assigns a physical spin, mutual orbit, mass distribution
or propagation rate to the role names.

The resulting local construction is

    C_a = -2B exp(i(phi_a-phi_p)),
    C_b = +2B exp(i(phi_b-phi_p)),
    E_B = 6 + Re(C_a+C_b).

static placement, with the core identities

```text

lambda_rate = omega_C * t_SW
E * t_SW = hbar * lambda

```

and the ledger/contact update

```text
dN_write = Gamma_res dt
dA_ledger = A0 Gamma_res dt
```

marks that functional open. It does supply the exact ordering: unresolved
support carries phase/exposure before contact, contact writes ledger
